target: docs/41-试点课堂Start持久迁移内核SDD.md
focus: PSK-SEC8-01 closure: fresh unique per-case key
protected key delivery and same-case restart recovery
summary: The SDD now requires a fresh, independent, unique 256-bit OS-CSPRNG HMAC key per case, prohibits cross-case reuse and fixed runtime keys, and reserves the fixed golden key for compile-time test vectors. Same-case child restart recovers the original key through the protected supervisor path. Previously reviewed ACL/mode, key-delivery, HMAC ordering, threat-boundary, and retention controls remain consistent. No new security blocker was identified in this review.

finding_dispositions.evidence: §3 requires a fresh independent unique 256-bit key from OS CSPRNG per case; forbids cross-case reuse, configured fixed values, or runtime golden/test key; says only compile-time test vectors use the fixed key; and specifies same-case supervisor recovery after restart.
§3 and §6 use protected inherited handle/anonymous pipe and prohibit argv, environment, logs, and dumps.
§4 derives tool_started task_hmac from Store-verified capability task ID and trace_hmac from Store decision ID, then cross-checks both against Registry AuditEntry after tool_result.
§3 retains per-open owner-only DACL/POSIX mode validation, protected key creation/delivery, and explicitly limits receipt-first integrity to the trusted local-account boundary.

§3 retains synthetic-only data, supervisor-only pending/degraded access, immediate success cleanup, terminal failure maximum 24 hours, pending/degraded maximum 7 days, grouped cleanup, and no reuse after cleanup failure.

limitations: No tests or runtime validation were run.
No key-generation, ACL/mode, key-transfer, build-artifact, database, or recovery behavior was inspected at runtime.
Approval is limited to the written isolated test-only security design; it does not establish implementation correctness, production readiness, or classroom readiness.
